notes.title: Speaking Simulator: Cooperative Multiplayer Update + 35% off!
notes.content:
Cooperative Multiplayer
Harness the power of 100%-real-human-friendship and cooperatively seduce Karen from HR. This feature works with Steam Remote Play, which means you can play online, or those lucky
enough to have a real “human” friend in close proximity can play couch co-op.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33812370/2d6ab9e8bcc7d33c36827095fe96aa34c596392e.gif

Easier Difficulty Options
Take control of your human emotions. You can now disable upgraded abilities at the beginning of a conversation. For those who want to challenge themselves you will be rewarded with score bonuses for displaying such beautiful empathy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33812370/6ef877c98e8f2a31c7eaa27411340ff825d51b43.gif

Twitch Integration 
Convert your Twitch audience into digital slaves. Streamers can now outsource the required emotional computation to their audience, letting them control various parts of the game. 

Command list follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33812370/b67969134cce2a2595b247faded2a282fb939de0.png

notes.title: Hello humans!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33812370/4e536e55009f2a5aca0584d781c6ebdec9366822.png

We think it's time to start updating you on cool Speaking Simulator stuff! If you didn’t catch us at PAX East, we showcased a whole bunch of new content and game play! Check it out:

Smiling AND Frowning
It's time to start expressing the emotions that you don't actually have. After installing some high tech Emotional Circuitry into your face, you can finally smile (or frown) at Karen from HR. Isn't she dreamy?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33812370/2d6ab9e8bcc7d33c36827095fe96aa34c596392e.gifhttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33812370/1295c1d4047541ce3012945a5997464d0890a33d.gif

Eye Looking
So you thought speaking was difficult? With the Socio-Optic upgrade you'll have to manage eye contact as well. It was.. Suspicious when you stared at someone for 15 minutes straight.

This is much better, right?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33812370/5bab7c1a69fb4fe3f049c782470ff9f2cb72122d.gifhttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33812370/52170b65fa824765609e2f65df12a771cb7a714f.gif

-

That's all for now! We're working hard on more new things and should have more to show soon.

If you think they would enjoy it, please tell your friends and family (humans only) about Speaking Simulator.

Romance Tip
Imagine you’re on a date. There's an awkward silence. You bring up the topic of Speaking Simulator and keep the conversation going. You both have a laugh. Your date thinks you’re really charming and cool, and you both fall in love. You get married and have babies. 40 years later as you talk to your grandchildren, you tell them about this steam announcement.
